subject: Restorative Justice Implementation and Budget Scheduling
overview: The School Committee reviewed efforts to reduce student suspensions through a new restorative justice pilot and implicit bias training funded by a recent state grant. The body also approved motions to formalize the budget schedule, increase policy transparency, and improve communications with out-of-district families.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved bills, payroll, and meeting minutes from January and February with minor clerical amendments.

items.title: Good of the Order Discussion
items.summary: Members discussed methods for tracking approved motions that have not yet been implemented, suggesting that pending items remain on the agenda until disposed of.

items.title: Superintendent's Update
items.summary: The Superintendent apologized for communication lapses during recent snow days affecting out-of-district students and highlighted student success in the BioBuilder Apprenticeship Challenge.

items.title: COVID-19 Operational Update
items.summary: Staff reported on grade-level vaccination rates and the district's transition from surveillance testing to distributing rapid at-home antigen tests.

items.title: Suspension and Discipline Report
items.summary: Administrators detailed professional development on implicit bias and restorative justice; the committee referred the pilot program and its future funding needs to the Rules, Policy, and Equity Subcommittee.

items.title: Hate Crimes Prevention Grant
items.summary: The district announced a $50,000 grant award to fund educator stipends for restorative justice training and the implementation of school climate surveys.

items.title: Support for Menstrual Product Legislation
items.summary: Approved a resolution supporting state legislation to increase access to disposable menstrual products in public schools and other facilities.

items.title: Agenda Formatting Amendment
items.summary: Approved an amendment to Policy DBEDB to reset agenda item numbering at the start of each calendar year.

items.title: Out-of-District Communication Policy
items.summary: Approved a motion to ensure families of students in out-of-district placements receive standard district notifications and frequently asked questions, subject to family consent.

items.title: Public Posting of School Committee Policies
items.summary: Approved a resolution requiring that all school committee policies and rules be posted in an easily accessible format on the district website.

items.title: School Committee Orientation
items.summary: Referred a motion to establish a formal annual orientation process for new and returning members to the Rules and Policy Subcommittee.

items.title: FY2023 Budget Schedule
items.summary: Approved a motion requiring the administration to publish the formal budget process and public meeting schedule by February 16, 2022.
